segments.sensitive: One reviewer in her 40s with sensitive, dry skin reported no irritation from the product but noted a slight orange cast.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s and 70s report visible smoothing and reduction of under-eye bags, with several becoming repeat buyers, though one mature user found it only tightened skin temporarily without reversing aging.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing their under-eye area as dry report the product increasing dryness, flaking, and even accentuating fine lines.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (50s-70s) report visible reduction in under-eye bags and smoother appearance, sometimes within minutes; one reviewer notes it is a temporary tightening effect that will not reverse signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the product itself causes dryness, flakiness, or a crepey look under the eyes; one rated it 6/10 on hydration despite not finding it heavy.
concerns.spots: A minority of reviewers targeting dark circles and discoloration report brightening and reduced discoloration; several others report no change in dark circle color despite tightening sensation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports a burning sensation and residue after application; another reports swelling and puffiness the morning after use, prompting a return.
